scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && node -e "try { require('fs').cpSync('dist', 'frontend/dist', { recursive: true }); } catch (e) {}"
scripts.vercel-build: npm run prisma:generate -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && node -e "try { require('fs').cpSync('dist', 'frontend/dist', { recursive: true }); } catch (e) {}"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run prisma:generate -w backend && npm run prisma:migrate -w backend && npm run seed -w backend
